section_off: The GitHub mirror is off: CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE is not set. Nothing to check, and the app alone is enough.
credential_file_read: The file CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE names can be read and is not empty (its content is not shown).
credential_file_unreadable: The file CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE names cannot be read: {path}.
credential_file_empty: The file CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE names holds nothing: {path}.
credential_file_link: The file CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE names is a link: name the file itself, so that its owner and mode are the ones checked.
credential_file_owner: The file CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE names belongs to another account than the one running this check.
credential_file_open: The file CLEARED_V2_MIRROR_GITHUB_TOKEN_FILE names can be read by other accounts of this machine (mode {mode}): run chmod 600 on it.
settings_refused: The service refuses the mirror's settings, so the mirror stays off: {reason}
workspace_refused: The workspace's settings are refused, so the mirror stays off: {reason}
project_missing: The mirror needs the project the service runs (CLEARED_V2_PROJECT or CLEARED_V2_WORKSPACE): without it, no repository to check.
repo_reached: {repo}: GitHub answers, its issues are on, and the token's account can label and close them.
repo_rights_unsaid: {repo}: GitHub answers and its issues are on. GitHub does not say what the token's account may do here: the mirror's first write will tell.
repo_issues_off: {repo}: its issues are turned off in the repository's settings, and the mirror needs them.
repo_read_only: {repo}: the token's account can read its issues but not label or close them: it needs the triage role at least.
repo_refused_401: {repo}: GitHub refuses the token (401): it is wrong, expired or revoked.
repo_refused_403: {repo}: GitHub answered 403: the token lacks a right this repository needs, or its rate limit is reached.
repo_refused_404: {repo}: GitHub answered 404: the repository does not exist, or the token cannot see it.
repo_unreachable: {repo}: no answer from {api}: the address is wrong, the network is down, or GitHub took more than {limit}.
labels_present: {repo}: every status label a person picks on GitHub's page exists: {labels}.
labels_missing: {repo}: missing status labels: {labels}. The mirror makes a label the first time it writes it, but until then no one can pick that state on GitHub's page.
mirror_recent: {repo}: the mirror's last full pass was {time}.
mirror_stale: {repo}: the mirror's last full pass was {time}, past the limit of {limit} (CLEARED_V2_HEARTBEAT_TRACKER_MINUTES): is the service running?
mirror_never: {repo}: the ledger holds no pass of the mirror yet: the service has not run it, or not on this repository.
ledger_missing: {repo}: the service's ledger cannot be read ({reason}), so its last pass is unknown.
